assets.exactPrompt: Edit target: the attached original Wanda PNG, used as the actual cutout sprite in an original picture-puzzle demo. Create ONE full-body transparent PNG of a lookalike bystander based very closely on this sprite. Keep the original female character's pose, facial features, dark-brown bob haircut, skin tone, narrow silhouette, long legs, shoes, outlines, scale/proportions and EXACT sweater stripe count, widths and placement. Change ONLY the sweater red to slightly muted warm coral red, approximately RGB(222,60,50), and the trousers from saturated blue to slightly muted denim-blue, approximately RGB(48,109,163). Keep the off-white stripes unchanged, approximately RGB(249,244,242). The result should look like a believable close cousin of Wanda with a subtly different outfit, drawn in the identical clean clip-art style. Original standing front view, arms down, no accessories, no hat, no scene, no text, no frame, no ground/shadow/glow or backdrop. Entire person including shoes fully visible, generous transparent padding, actual alpha transparency. Preserve geometry tightly rather than inventing a new character or changing clothing design.
